Domino, et noli oblivisci omnes retributiones ejus.
O my soul, and do not forget all his recompenses.
qui redimit de interitu vitam tuam;
He redeems your life from destruction.
qui coronat te in misericordia et miserationibus:
He crowns you with mercy and compassion.
qui replet in bonis desiderium tuum;
He satisfies your desire with good things.
Your youth will be renewed like that of the eagle.
and his judgment is for all who patiently endure injuries.
He has made his ways known to Moses,
his will to the sons of Israel.
The Lord is compassionate and merciful,
He will not be angry forever,
and he will not threaten for eternity.
Non secundum peccata nostra fecit nobis,
He has not dealt with us according to our sins,
neque secundum iniquitates nostras retribuit nobis.
and he has not repaid us according to our iniquities.
Quoniam secundum altitudinem cæli a terra,
For according to the height of the heavens above the earth,
corroboravit misericordiam suam super timentes se;
so has he reinforced his mercy toward those who fear him.
As far as the east is from the west,
longe fecit a nobis iniquitates nostras.
so far has he removed our iniquities from us.
As a father is compassionate to his sons,
so has the Lord been compassionate to those who fear him.
He has called to mind that we are dust.

For the spirit in him will pass away,
et non cognoscet amplius locum suum.
and he will know his place no longer.
But the mercy of the Lord is from eternity,
et usque in æternum super timentes eum.
and even unto eternity, upon those who fear him.
Et justitia illius in filios filiorum,
And his justice is with the sons of the sons,
with those who serve his covenant
et memores sunt mandatorum ipsius ad faciendum ea.
and have been mindful of his commandments by doing them.
Dominus in cælo paravit sedem suam,
The Lord has prepared his throne in heaven,
and his kingdom will rule over all.
